DML.SELECT: SELECT plan_id as "id", plan_mode_type_id as "planModeTypeId", alias as "alias", description as "description", management_area_id as "managementAreaId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.plans WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.plans (plan_id, plan_mode_type_id, alias, description, management_area_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.plans'$'plan_id'}, :planModeTypeId, :alias, :description, :managementAreaId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.plans SET plan_mode_type_id = :planModeTypeId, alias = :alias, description = :description, management_area_id = :managementAreaId, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE plan_id = :id
